name: EvictableSlot

test_list.description: Concurrent callers share one owner-managed load.
Canceling one acquisition does not cancel the shared load needed by other waiters.
The configured maximum lease count is enforced.
A timed drain does not unload active leases, keeps admission paused, and resumes only explicitly.
A forced eviction requested during a shared load drains the resulting real model before admissions reopen.
Only a loaded slot beyond its idle TTL unloads, and a later acquire performs a new load.
Shutdown closes admission and an actual unload failure remains observable and retryable.
An unload timeout is reported without claiming successful release or detaching owner work.

inputs.name: loader
inputs.description: Real backend lifecycle operations supplied by the composition root.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Idle TTL, lease bound, load timeout and unload timeout.

inputs.name: deadline
inputs.description: Maximum caller wait for requested eviction or close.

output_description: A shared loader-backed slot with single-flight loading, RAII leases and observable eviction outcomes.
